site.title: AzraelGodKing — RimWorld Mods
site.tagline: RimWorld mods for colonies that farm, harden, dig, remember, make time for each other, and keep the small comforts.
site.heroIntro: Seven mods. One workshop. Open a mod page for details — or jump straight to Steam or zip downloads if you cannot use the Workshop. Every mod ships as a GitHub release zip; extract into your RimWorld Mods folder. All mods need Harmony.
site.author: AzraelGodKing

mods.name: Homesteader
mods.tagline: Tribal pantry, orchard and dairy, wells and irrigation, cool cellars, livestock, and off-grid power for homestead starts.
overview: Grow it, put it by, live off the land. Homesteader is the farmstead kit: tribal drying from day one, dairy and hearth meals, orchard trees and bees, wells and irrigation, cool cellars, livestock and textiles, and batteries when the glitterworld grid is a rumor.

The Homesteaders scenario starts three settlers with livestock and hand tools, and locks the Azrael storyteller. A homestead supplier caravan visits with preserves, seeds, and the occasional Diggo plushie. The Pantry colony tab tracks what you put by and what is about to turn.

features.title: Preserve without a freezer
features.body: Dry, salt, smoke, can, and pack from a tribal start. The drying rack needs no research; curing and smoking unlock with Primitive homestead. Surplus becomes stores that survive the caravan and the cold snap.

features.title: Drying, curing, smoking
features.body: Drying rack: jerky, fruit leather, dried produce, dried mushrooms, and pemmican. Curing rack: rock salt and salted meat. Smokehouse: smoked meat — and smoked fish with Odyssey.

features.title: Cool storage
features.body: Root cellar (≤5°C, the large larder), icehouse (≤0°C, colder and smaller), and springhouse (≤8°C, dairy and produce by the farmhouse). Hayloft and ingredient barrels for bulk farm storage.

features.title: Pantry tab
features.body: Colony tab over cellar, icehouse, springhouse, preserves shelf, crates, and barrels: distinct preserved kinds, days of food, and the next stack to rot.

features.title: Spoilage triage & crates
features.body: On by default, colonists eat and preserve the stack closest to turning. Pack a mixed preserve crate at the jam cauldron or canning kitchen for trade in one click.

features.title: A kitchen that earns its keep
features.body: Mill grain, churn butter, press cheese, pickle, jam, brew, and plate pantry meals at the homestead hearth. Recipes lean on cream, sugar, fruit, maple, honey, and smoked leftovers — not a chemfuel factory.

features.title: Dairy and hearth
features.body: Skim cream, churn butter (+ buttermilk) or press cheese; wax or smoke the cheese. Pantry meals: toast and jam, ploughman's lunch, honey porridge, pumpkin pie, buttermilk biscuits. The hearth cooks; the wood stove only heats.

features.title: Orchard and apiary
features.body: Apple and cherry trees for cider, jam, and eating fresh. Tap sugar maple and boil sap into syrup, then griddle flapjacks. Beehives make honey and beeswax; render slow-burning candles.

features.title: Canning, cider, soap
features.body: Canning kitchen (mason jars, canned stew and jam), cider press (juice then cider), wash tub and homestead soap. Favorite-food mood for every humanlike — Homesteader and vanilla pool.

features.title: Livestock and fiber
features.body: Chicken coop for eggs; animal mash from barley, pumpkin, or hay. Render lard and stuff sausage. Flax, spinning wheel, loom, and homestead quilts — quilted beds need a quilt.

features.title: Soil
features.body: Compost heap → fertilizer → composted soil (+45% fertility). Seed saving: harvest drops saved seed; replant and the line slowly takes to this soil.

features.title: Around the farmhouse
features.body: Preserves shelf for jams, pickles, cheese, dairy, honey, and syrup. Nesting box for small animals. Harvest maypole for gathering cheer.

features.title: Polyarmory
features.body: Polycule members with the trait are fine sharing multi-person beds (works with Polyamory Beds).

features.title: Water that feeds the fields
features.body: Former Wellspring content ships inside Homesteader. Catch, store, haul, and trench water into irrigated soil. Disable any old standalone Wellspring mod.

features.title: Catch and store
features.body: Rain barrel is a cheap trickle. Cistern stores eight stacks, stops rot, and fills itself. Water tower holds twenty-four stacks, catches faster, and hauls as Critical.

features.title: Wells and still
features.body: Hand-dug well: five jugs on demand. Deep well: twenty jugs a haul. Solar still is the arid sidegrade — boiled water without a stove. Stone fountain drinks about two jugs a day; courtyard beauty only while it flows.

features.title: Irrigation and goods
features.body: Irrigated soil and planter (+30% fertility). Boiled water, mud bricks, and clean bandages from water.

features.title: Plumbing bridge
features.body: With Dubs Bad Hygiene, rain barrel / cistern / water tower store plumbing water; the hand-dug well is a primitive groundwater source and the deep well a piped inlet. Jug irrigation still works.

features.title: Power without the glitterworld
features.body: Compact batteries and wood-fired generators keep a homestead lit when the grid fails. Stormproof grid defense runs on these cells.

features.title: Batteries
features.body: Compact, bank, advanced, and ultratech cells for tight footprints.

features.title: Generators
features.body: Portable chemfuel and wood-burning options for rural power.

features.title: Homestead techs
features.body: Primitive homestead, food preservation, farmstead crafting, homestead storage, brewing, comforts, advanced homestead, livestock, textiles, soil and cold storage, pantry craft. Wellcraft → irrigation / waterworks.

features.title: Homesteaders scenario
features.body: Three settlers, livestock, and hand tools — far from the glitterworld supply chain. Locks the Azrael storyteller. A homestead supplier visits with preserves, seeds, and the occasional Diggo plushie.

features.title: Azrael storyteller
features.body: Cassandra-style pacing with a bit more Misc / ThreatSmall for series flavor. Canonical copy ships here; sibling scenarios lock it when Homesteader is loaded.

stationFaq.title: Which station do I want?
stationFaq.intro: Similar names, different jobs — nothing here is a duplicate.

rows.answer: Drying rack needs no research: jerky, dried produce, fruit leather, dried mushrooms, pemmican. Curing rack (Primitive homestead) salts meat and chips rock salt.

rows.pair: Root cellar vs icehouse vs springhouse
rows.answer: Root cellar is the large passive larder (≤5°C). Icehouse is colder and smaller (≤0°C). Springhouse is milder (≤8°C) for dairy and produce by the farmhouse.
Homestead hearth cooks pantry meals. Wood stove only heats the room, off-grid — it does not cook.

goodToKnow: The drying rack needs no research. Curing and smoking unlock with Primitive homestead.
Smoked fish requires the Odyssey DLC.
Former Wellspring water content lives here — disable any old standalone Wellspring mod.
Optional refresh art is not in the Workshop zip. Copy Textures/HomesteaderRefresh from GitHub into the mod folder, then Mod Options → Use refreshed textures.
Chinese Simplified and Russian are included.
Safe to add to an existing save. Before removing, deconstruct Homesteader buildings and use up or sell its items.

mods.name: Stormproof
mods.tagline: Defend the power grid from flares, lightning, short circuits, EMP, and fallout — then call the storm yourself.
overview: The Rim does not care about your freezer. Stormproof is the Power-tab toolkit that keeps a colony running through flares, lightning, surges, EMP, fallout, heat, cold, eclipses, flashstorms, and droughts.
Eighteen tools for a disaster-hardened colony — plus brownout, storm wear, a weather almanac, and the Stormfront showcase start. Pairs naturally with Homesteader batteries and generators.

features.title: Solar shield
features.body: Keeps every electrical device on the map running during a solar flare. Idles cheap; drinks 2,500W while the sky is red. If batteries empty mid-flare, the shield collapses and everything stays dark until the flare ends.

features.title: Storm spire
features.body: Steals lightning in a wide radius (shown on select and while placing), cannot burn, and snuffs fires at its base. Wired: each strike dumps up to 1,500 Wd into capacitors then batteries, with a small Zzzt risk until Perfect grounding. Unwired: just a safe rod. Every eight strikes fuses fulgurite at the base.

features.title: Storm capacitor bank
features.body: Lightning-only storage. The grid cannot charge it; Zzzt cannot drain it; it never leaks. Covers deficits up to 2,000W.

features.title: Surge protector
features.body: Eats one Zzzt, then spends a day recharging. Pairs dangerously well with a grid-connected storm spire.

features.title: Armored conduit
features.body: Fireproof, tough, and immune to storm wear — the wiring for killboxes and exterior walls.

features.title: Load shedder
features.body: Automatic breaker between the main grid and a low-priority sub-grid. Battery cutoff still trips first. Add a 24-hour run/shed timetable, a forecast override that sheds before a storm or flare, and Hold Auto / Run / Shed. Old saves keep the old breaker until you set a schedule.

features.title: Grid monitor
features.body: Live production, consumption, battery time-to-empty, brownout level, and charge warnings. With a forecaster on the same net it projects eight hours of solar/wind vs weather, then a typical sky after it breaks.

features.title: Graded brownout
features.body: When batteries fall below 40%, lights dim, workbenches slow, and coolers lag — draw drops so remaining charge lasts longer. A load shedder still cuts the sub-grid at its trip point.

features.title: Storm wear
features.body: Thunder, ion storms, and high wind slowly chip ordinary conduit and batteries. Armored conduit and storm capacitor banks are immune. Repair as usual.

features.title: Coverage rings
features.body: Place and select draw the live radius on the storm spire, static pylon, EMP dampener, and fire suppressor. The fallout scrubber highlights its enclosed room.

features.title: EMP dampener
features.body: Colony buildings in range shrug off EMP stuns. Turrets keep firing. Does not protect pawns or mechanoids.

features.title: Static discharge pylon
features.body: Runs on bottled lightning: every shock drains a storm capacitor bank on its power net, stunning and burning raiders and mechanoids. No capacitor charge, no zap.

features.title: Fallout scrubber
features.body: Indoor detox for pawns and animals in the enclosed room. Useless outdoors. Pair with the atmospheric barrier to clear toxin already in the blood.

features.title: Weather forecaster
features.body: How long this weather holds, incoming thunderstorms, an hour's warning before it breaks, and a year-log of this map's storms and hazards. The almanac ledger tracks strikes caught vs missed, Zzzt absorbed vs suffered, fires snuffed, and wear hits.

features.title: Spacer counters
features.body: Late-game map-wide buildings. Idle cheap; pull hard while the event is on. No stored energy, no protection.

features.title: Atmospheric barrier
features.body: Toxic fallout, toxic surge, volcanic ash, and noxious haze.

features.title: Climate stabilizer
features.body: Heat wave, cold snap, volcanic winter, heat dome, polar front.

features.title: Sky restorer
features.body: Usable daylight during eclipses, volcanic winters, ash, and darkened skies.

features.title: Fire suppressor
features.body: Extinguishes fires in a wide radius (flashstorm / dry lightning).

features.title: Drought condenser
features.body: Cancels drought plant-growth penalties (Odyssey). Harmless furniture if droughts never arrive.

features.title: Storm caller
features.body: Summon a rainy thunderstorm on demand: lightning to feed spires, rain to douse wildfires. Half-day storm, five-day recharge — a supplement to the grid, not a replacement.

features.title: Storm vane
features.body: A handsome copper weather vane. It predicts nothing. Every proper homestead has one.

features.title: Stormfront scenario
features.body: A hard-weather showcase start that unlocks storm protection research, and locks Azrael when Homesteader is loaded.

features.title: Ion storm
features.body: Batteries bleed, EMP bursts pop at powered buildings, and extra Zzzt shorts fire. Dampeners, surge protectors, and storm capacitors are the answer.

features.title: Matching weather
features.body: Dry lightning front, heat dome, polar front, and toxic surge each pressure a different counter. Vanilla flares, fallout, flashstorms, heat/cold, eclipse, volcanic winter, and drought are covered once hazard hardening is online.

features.title: Research tab
features.body: Electricity → storm protection → flare shielding → atmospheric control / perfect grounding → hazard hardening. Dedicated Stormproof research tab.

features.title: Settings
features.body: Soft / Default / Hard. Per-incident toggles and frequency, suppressor toggles, brownout strength, storm wear, almanac, fulgurite, and spire Zzzt chance.

goodToKnow: Stockpile battery charge before the sky goes red — if the grid runs dry mid-flare, the solar shield collapses until the flare ends.
A grid-connected storm spire has a small Zzzt chance per caught strike until Perfect grounding; Soft / Default / Hard change that factor.
Storm capacitor banks are lightning-only — the grid cannot charge them, and spires fill capacitors before regular batteries.
Spire vs shield: the spire is lightning and fire. The shield is flares. You usually want both.
Chinese Simplified and Russian are included. Odyssey is optional (drought condenser).
Safe to add mid-save. Deconstruct all Stormproof buildings before removing the mod.

compatibleWith.note: Pairs naturally with Homesteader batteries and generators

compatibleWith.note: Nemesis EMP sabotage respects EMP dampeners; surge protectors blunt its grid sabotage

mods.name: Strata
mods.tagline: Dig down, build up, breathe deep. Multistory bases with commuting colonists and Odyssey-ready stacks.
overview: One home, many floors. Carve rock under your colony, frame a roof deck above it, and treat every floor as one settlement. Colonists commute for work, food, rest, hauling, medicine, combat, and construction. Heat, power, smoke, and (optionally) pipes follow the shafts with them.

Tag floors as Farm, Freezer, Workshop, Barracks, Quarry, Storage, or Hospital so hauls and rest tilt the right way. Stamp walls onto the next level. Call the elevator. See and shoot through open sky. Odyssey gravship stacks stay linked through launch and land.

Odyssey unlocks gravship stairwells and ship stacks only — dig, tower decks, atmosphere, and colony logistics work without the DLC. Default level cap is ±2 (Unlimited off). Do not run alongside AASB, AASB 2, or MultiFloors.

features.title: They commute
features.body: Idle colonists notice mining, blueprints, hauling, and bills on other levels and walk the stairs. Hungry and sleepy pawns find meals and beds across the stack. Haulers deliver through shafts; force-build pulls materials from linked stockpiles.

features.title: Level purpose tags
features.body: Farm, Freezer, Workshop, Barracks, Quarry, Storage, Hospital, or none — set from the rename dialog or the Levels tab. Matching tags only tilt equal-priority hauls and rest; wrong tags never block a job.

features.title: Levels tab tools
features.body: Rename floors, stamp walls/doors/floors (and optional stockpiles) onto a linked floor as blueprints, call / hold / priority elevators, and toggle a support overlay for excavated cells past a roof holder.

features.title: See-below roof decks
features.body: Look through open sky and see-through deck into the map below — terrain, buildings, live pawns and projectiles. Click-select, float menus, and forbidden overlays work on what you can see.

features.title: Cross-level combat
features.body: Pawns, turrets, and mortars fire through open shafts and sky holes. Combat Extended guns included. Auto-engage keeps decks and underfloors in the fight without hopping maps by hand.

features.title: Dig down
features.body: Research digging down, build an excavated stairwell, open a full-size rock level under your map. Deeper floors need deep excavation. Extra shafts join the same level. Thick rock roof — no drop pods, mortars, or weather from the sky.

features.title: Build up
features.body: Research building up, frame a tower stairwell, open outdoor Level +N as a roof deck — walk and build where the floor below is roofed. Expand roofs downstairs to grow the deck. Page Up / Page Down jump floors.

features.title: Elevators
features.body: Compact 1×1 cars — power to descend; ride up even if power fails. Call sends selected colonists through this car. Hold keeps it off hops to a third floor. Priority 1–5 weights automatic routing.

features.title: Deep Shafts scenario
features.body: Mountain/shaft showcase start; unlocks Digging Down + Building Up; locks Azrael when Homesteader is loaded.

features.title: Heat and gases
features.body: Stairwells exchange temperature — heat rises fast, cold pools below. Buoyant gases rise through open shafts; heavy gases sink. Optional atmosphere sim (gases default off): smoke, deep gas, O₂, CO₂ in sealed rooms. Overlay in play settings.

features.title: Living below
features.body: Shoring, gas airlocks, ore hoists, fungus farms, sump pumps, mine lamps, bellows, lime scrubbers — plus a deep-gas well and smokeless generator.

features.title: Support overlay
features.body: Play-settings toggle outlines excavated cells under thick rock that are past a roof holder or shoring pillar. Cave-in incidents pick those cells first.

features.title: Excavated / tower stairwell
features.body: Opens B− or A+. Ties power when wired. Seal to stop gas and raiders. Elevators do the same in 1×1 with a power gate on the paid direction.

features.title: Shaft power conduit
features.body: Optional dedicated tie away from the stair footprint — builds its partner below automatically. Tankless pockets still wake from shaft surplus.

features.title: Ventilation kit
features.body: Smoke hole (no research), louvers, exhaust fans, updraft filters, gas pipes. A working outlet keeps a room under harmful smoke.

features.title: Life support
features.body: O₂ / CO₂ pumps, shaft exchangers, canary cages. Medieval bellows and lime scrubbers if you're not industrial yet. Gravship O₂ reclaimers and tanks when Odyssey is loaded.

features.title: Deep gas & wells
features.body: Cap a vent, burn canisters in the deep-gas generator, or feed Helixien pipes when Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded is present.

features.title: Gravship stacks
features.body: Ship-only stairwells open A+/B+ pockets that travel on launch and reattach on landing. Colony dig/tower stairs cannot sit on substructure — use gravship shafts on the ship. Soft-compatible with Vanilla Gravship Expanded — Chapter 1.

features.title: Away into the dark
features.body: World sites: sunken ruins, collapsed mines, sealed vaults, geothermal vents.

features.title: At home
features.body: Cave breakthroughs, gas firestorms, flood seeps, rich ore nodes, deep sieges, burrowing raiders, optional ancient stairwells. Sky threats stay upstairs. Seal a stairwell to contain gas or bugs — and your own colonists.

features.title: Fluid shafts
features.body: Soft-dep junctions for Dubs Bad Hygiene, Dubs Central Heating, Rimatomics, Vanilla Helixien Gas Expanded, Rimefeller, and VEF chemfuel — meter across levels without merging pipe nets.

features.title: Modder API & soft-compat
features.body: Strata.StrataModderApi for reachable maps and link listeners. Soft bridges for Vehicle Framework roof decks, VGE Chapter 1, ReGrowth underdecks, Combat Extended cross-floor fire, and sister mods in this series. Cave mods (Deep And Deeper, Anomaly undercaves) stay invisible to Strata's relays by default — an opt-in setting extends relays into their caves.

features.title: Own Strata tab
features.body: Medieval opens floors; industrial keeps them livable.

features.title: Building up
features.body: Unlocks the tower stairwell and Level A+.

features.title: Digging down
features.body: Opens B1; Deep excavation opens B2+ and quest sites.

features.title: Electricity branch
features.body: Elevators and Shaft power, then Fluid shafts.

features.title: Forced ventilation
features.body: Leads to Deep life support and Deep gas extraction.

features.title: Support techs
features.body: Rock shoring, Passive life support, Deep infrastructure, Deep agriculture, Mine atmosphere.

goodToKnow: Leave pillars under thick rock roof — or research shoring. The support overlay shows cells past a holder.
Seal a shaft to stop raiders and gas; it also traps your own people. Stairwells cannot be torn down while anyone is still on the linked level.
Grow A+ by expanding roofs downstairs; open sky never holds buildings, but you can see and shoot through it.
On Odyssey ships, only gravship stairwells place on the footprint; dig/tower stairs stay planet-side.
Don't dig Strata shafts on temporary quest maps (Ancient Urban Ruins, world sites) — Strata is for your home colony.
Every level is a full same-size map. Prefer a smaller map if you plan many deep floors. Default cap ±2.
Leave Natural / Pollutant gases off unless you want the atmosphere sim; use Performance mode to A/B lag.
Safe to add mid-save. Before removing: bring everyone up, haul what you care about, deconstruct all stairwells.

notes: Cave / pocket-map mods (Deep And Deeper, Anomaly undercaves, and similar) are compatible: their portal maps are invisible to Strata's level system by default. The opt-in setting "Relay into other mods' portal maps" extends cross-level relays to them.
Mods adding fuel-burning buildings are not auto-tagged by heuristic; only a named vanilla/DLC list plus XML patches get smoke comps.
Multi-level mods that patch pathfinding or map generation globally are the most likely source of conflicts; Strata deliberately patches neither.

mods.name: Nemesis
mods.tagline: A named antagonist who taunts, sabotages, and returns with an army — until you end the hunt.
overview: Someone remembers. Someone is coming back. A named pawn from a hostile faction becomes a personal antagonist — not another faceless raid. Early on they harass with taunts, false leads, and sabotage. After each escape they level up as a combat captain and prefer returning with an army. The hunt still ends when you capture or kill them… or when they get what they came for.
The Dossier tab tracks identity, tells, sightings, and a standing bounty. Original design and core runtime by Dredd (Misakabob). Expanded and packaged here by AzraelGodKing with gratitude.

features.title: Killed ally or kin
features.body: A colonist kills someone's ally or kin. Someone takes it personally. Colony executions of prisoners do not start this hunt.

features.title: Prison break / slave escape
features.body: A prisoner (or Ideology slave) breaks out — and a former friend of the colony does not forgive it.

features.title: Wounded escape
features.body: An enemy is wounded, escapes the map, then comes back for the colonist who cut them. Headless returns restore missing parts so they can actually fight.

features.title: Fixation
features.body: An enemy who killed one of yours fixates on a surviving colonist and makes it personal.

features.title: Marked scenario
features.body: Personal-antagonist showcase start (flak + revolvers); locks Azrael when Homesteader is loaded.

features.title: Main tab
features.body: Identity, tells, sightings, taunts, last-known tile, gear seen, and aggression for the active hunt.

features.title: Tells
features.body: Voice register, weapon family, mark, and habit roll at hunt create and never change. Progression upgrades quality, not weapon type.

features.title: Informants and bounty
features.body: Pay silver at a comms console (or the dossier) for a lead: tile, gear, next-raid warning, or a false lead. Standing bounty is recorded on the dossier.

features.title: Epitaph
features.body: Hunt end writes a permanent record on the dossier. Fail-open copy onto Deep Colony's Legacy letters when that mod is loaded.

features.title: Taunts & notes
features.body: Comms taunts and paper notes that name your people. Soft-compat lines can reference Homesteader cellars / favorites and Stormproof ion flavor when those mods are loaded.

features.title: Raids & vengeance army
features.body: Faction raids — and after escapes, vengeance army returns that inject the same nemesis into a heavier assault. Why return alone when you can return with an army? Raid points also scale with captain level.

features.title: Captain progression
features.body: Each escape raises captain level: combat focus (Destroyer, Berserker, Sniper, Psycho, Survivor, Mechanitor), better skills and gear, battle-hardened armor. Biotech can add bionics/genes. Soft animal escorts and Mechanitor mech retinues when those systems are present. Still killable after enough escapes — no cheat-death.

features.title: Personal assault
features.body: On-map assaults that pull back when losing. They heal between escapes so the hunt keeps coming.

features.title: False signals
features.body: Fake distress / trader offers that become delayed ambushes (downweighted after escapes).

features.title: Sabotage & waste
features.body: EMP / grid sabotage, Biotech waste drops, caravan harassment, and food-store vandalism — common early; less likely once they start returning as a captain.

features.title: Anomaly bait
features.body: Optional Anomaly baiting when that DLC is active (fail-open without it).

features.title: Capture
features.body: Arrest them alive, then Execute / Release / Keep / Truce from the resolution dialog.

features.title: Corner & kill
features.body: After enough escapes they can finally be finished for good.

features.title: They win
features.body: If they hunt a specific colonist, the hunt also ends if that pawn dies or is handed over — they get what they came for.

goodToKnow: Trigger chances, aggression pacing, and the action mix are configurable in mod settings.
No cheat-death — the nemesis is still killable after enough escapes.
Chinese Simplified and Russian are included.
Safe to add mid-save; resolve any active hunt before removing the mod.

mods.name: Deep Colony
mods.tagline: Auto skill perks, trauma & therapy, apprenticeship, family life, and a living faction reputation ledger.
overview: Your colonists are more than their stats. Five interlocking systems give each colonist a real identity — and make the colony feel like it has a living history. Not more furniture. Not another raid timer.

Four surfaces: Perks, Legacy, Reputation, and a Family inspect tab (Rows or Pedigree). Soft and Default keep power systems and attitude consequences off; Hard enables skill-20 capstones, branching perks, chronic trauma, and attitude-driven trade / caravan / raid pressure.

features.title: Perks
features.body: Every colonist's trees at a glance, filters, and archetypes on each row. Perks grant themselves at skill 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 — no points to spend. If the skill drops, that perk lapses.

features.title: Legacy
features.body: Founder bloodlines, teaching lineages, traumatized count, remembrance names, estate heir, and Export chronicle (clipboard + a text file next to RimWorld saves).

features.title: Reputation
features.body: Per-faction ledger: what moved goodwill, when, and what drift is still pending. Ally / hostile filter, tribute, envoy visit.

features.title: Family inspect
features.body: Kin on the Character pane — Rows or Pedigree. Click a relative to jump to them. Dead kin included; teaching line listed separately.

features.title: Auto skill perks
features.body: At skill 5, 10, 15, and 20 the matching perk grants itself. Hediffs stay off the Health tab unless Show perk hediffs is on. Every skill has its own tree, with exact numbers in the tooltips.

features.title: Muscle memory
features.body: Perks slow skill rust — and reclaiming lost levels earns double XP.

features.title: Capstones & branches
features.body: Skill 20 unlocks a capstone (on by default). Level 15 can be a branching pick. Respec at the cost of a cooldown and a bruised ego. Mentor retraining (Hard) lets a mentor who owns the other branch retrain an apprentice over eight sessions.

features.title: Cross-skill archetypes
features.body: Colonists whose perks span the right skills grow into archetypes — a named identity with its own bonus, earned from how they actually lived.

features.title: Trauma types
features.body: Combat shock, violent loss, captivity, massacre survivor, bereavement, fire, toxins, insects, and betrayal. Anomaly horror and Odyssey isolation when those DLCs are loaded. Trauma fades over weeks.

features.title: Known triggers
features.body: After the first flashback, inspect names what sets the colonist off — hidden until that first reaction, same discovery habit as Homesteader allergies.

features.title: Counsel
features.body: Doctors run one-on-one or group counseling (or right-click Counsel). Quality scales with Social, opinion, and the room. Casual therapy chats still help. Quiet indoor rooms bonus; Quiet Hours noise from benches and generators makes sleep and counsel worse.

features.title: Scars & resilience
features.body: Recovery leaves a lingering scar — or resilience. Three counsel sessions forge a confidant bond. On Hard, untreated trauma can settle into chronic stress.

features.title: Untreated alert
features.body: An alert nudges you after a one-day grace if trauma is still sitting.

features.title: Pair veteran and rookie
features.body: Right-click to pick the skill. Mentors must lead by 3+ skill levels; family only needs 2. Sibling bonds discount the gap further.

features.title: Mentoring work
features.body: Dedicated Mentoring work type. A Biotech blackboard in the room boosts XP; two or more apprentices plus a blackboard is a classroom extra.

features.title: Elders
features.body: Colonists past 60 slow down at labor but shine as mentors, and earn one late perk. A dying mentor can finish one last teach.

features.title: Graduation & rivalry
features.body: Graduating apprentices can pick up their mentor's first perk — and maybe a new passion. Professional rivals in the same craft push each other's XP.

features.title: Inheritance
features.body: Children and recruits with colonist parents or grandparents can inherit traits and passions. Families develop skill traditions. Colony-born children carry founder surnames. Heirlooms pass on death.

features.title: Estate
features.body: Name an heir on the Legacy tab. On death, named heir (else oldest child, else spouse) inherits; other children get a passed-over thought.

features.title: Family join & beats
features.body: Kin on the map may join from visits or defect from raids. Ex-lovers may reconcile. Family meals, homecoming, empty nest, last of the line, in-law welcome, and more sit on the same toggle.

features.title: Touch-need traits
features.body: Touch-averse, touch-starved, tactile, and cuddly share a closeness meter. Romance waits until that person reaches the required comfort tier. Date Night still owns romance schedules.

features.title: Divorce
features.body: Right-click a spouse to dissolve the marriage. Children get a short thought; Legacy letter. Date Night still owns romance jobs.

features.title: Living goodwill
features.body: Raids, trades, gifts, and shared-enemy kills nudge goodwill. Strong friendships and deep enmities slowly drift — allies don't collapse overnight from idle drift.

features.title: Personal envoys
features.body: Assign a colonist as envoy for steady goodwill — but if they die, the relationship takes it personally. Titled Royalty envoys add a little extra. Envoy visit is a settings-gated pulse to an allied settlement.

features.title: Tribute
features.body: Right-click silver / gold / jade as tribute, or spend 200 silver from the Reputation tab for a ledger goodwill row.

features.title: Settlement epithets
features.body: Settlements earn epithets from your shared history — grudges and favors written on the world map.

features.title: Attitude has teeth
features.body: On Hard, trade prices, caravan access, and raid pressure follow how factions actually feel about you.

goodToKnow: Soft and Default keep branching power systems and attitude consequences off; Hard enables branching L15 picks, chronic trauma, and attitude-driven trade / caravan / raid pressure. Skill-20 capstones default on.
Perk hediffs stay off the Health tab unless Show perk hediffs is on.
Birth safety net (default on) keeps race-mod newborns from failing generation.
Deep Roots scenario is a generational-colony showcase start; locks Azrael when Homesteader is loaded.
Safe to add mid-save. Requires Harmony.

mods.name: Date Night
mods.tagline: Paint Date or Lovin on the Schedule tab. Dates are dinner, walks, and stars; Lovin still uses a double.
overview: Schedule romance. Make memories. Date hours pick a real activity from what's around — dinner, picnic, walk, stargazing, dancing, a small gift, recreation, or a hangout. Mood and opinion only. No bed, no pregnancy. Paint Lovin on both partners for the same hours and they meet in a shared double.
Dates have quality. Couples remember a favourite spot. A finished date leaves a spark. Adults without a partner in that bed can have some private time. Children never qualify.

features.title: 1. Paint Date or Lovin
features.body: Open Schedule: Date is the extra-row face; Lovin sits in the ▾ menu. Vanilla hardcodes that grid, so XML alone never shows a custom slot. With Rimbody, Exosuit, or Schedule Everything, they sit in the next free extra columns so those mods keep Workout / Piloting.

features.title: 2. Date hours
features.body: Assign the same hours on both lovers. They pick one shared venue — dinner at a table, picnic outdoors, a walk, stargazing at night, dancing at a gather spot, a small gift (beer, chocolate…), recreation, or hangout. Mood and opinion only. Ideology rituals are not yanked mid-ceremony.

features.title: 3. Lovin hours
features.body: Each paths to a shared rendezvous double (claimed for the window, then restored). When both are in it, lovin uses a short MTB. Ideology that forbids lovin, or Biotech sterile genes, reroute to a date instead. Adults without a partner in that bed can have private time. Children never qualify.

features.title: 4. Show up
features.body: If a partner is drafted, in a medical bed, or off-map for the window, the one who waited gets a short stood-up thought. Hungry, chemical desire, player-forced jobs, and exhaustion still come first. After a finished date the couple waits a lovin-length cooldown before another scheduled date.

features.title: Wonderful / nice / awkward
features.body: Venue beauty, weather, activity, and a little luck decide the evening. Off in settings for a flat nice-date thought.

features.title: Ruined date
features.body: A raid, draft, or mental break after the date properly started leaves a ruined-date mood.

features.title: Favourite spots
features.body: Couples remember the venue of finished dates and prefer to go back. A ruined date can sour that place.

features.title: Post-date spark
features.body: A finished date improves lovin chance for about a day.

features.title: Anniversaries
features.body: Letter on the love-bond anniversary. A date that actually lands that day is a special mood; letting the day pass without one stings.

features.title: Double dates
features.body: Two couples with overlapping Date hours may share a venue. Quality rolls once; the evening spills into opinions of the other pair. If the other couple never shows, they date alone.

features.title: Pregnancy-safe cooldown
features.body: Only shortens lovin chance while scheduled; keeps vanilla post-lovin cooldown so pregnancy rolls stay sane.

features.title: Eager mode
features.body: Also shortens post-lovin cooldown like Always Do Lovin. Can spam pregnancy rolls — leave off unless you want that.

features.title: Allow private time
features.body: Adults on Lovin hours use any bed when a couple job cannot start. Mood thought only — no pregnancy. Same cooldown as lovin. Children never qualify.

features.title: Claim double for Lovin hours
features.body: Temporarily assign the rendezvous double to the couple, then restore their previous beds when the window ends.

features.title: Date activities / quality / gifts
features.body: Turn activities off for plain hangout dates. Quality off for a flat nice thought. Gift dates consume a small luxury item.

features.title: Date
features.body: Love relationship, both scheduled Date, same map — adults only.

features.title: Lovin
features.body: Both scheduled Lovin, reachable shared double (claimed for the window).

features.title: Mismatch alert
features.body: A schedule mismatch alert fires if only one lover has Date or Lovin painted (or they painted different hours).

features.title: Private time
features.body: Adult colonist, Lovin hours, any reachable bed (toggle in settings).

features.title: Ideology / Biotech
features.body: No-lovin precepts and sterile genes reroute to Date.

features.title: No-sleep pawns
features.body: Works for no-sleep / low-rest pawns who never hit a Sleep block.

goodToKnow: Safe to add mid-save. Before removing, clear Date / Lovin slots back to Sleep / Anything.
Chinese Simplified and Russian are included.
With Dev mode on, a Date Night menu can make a selected pair lovers, click-to-pair, paint Lovin or Date all day, force lovin / private time / date now, and log the rendezvous bed.
After installing, open a colonist's Schedule tab — Date is the extra-row face; Lovin is in the ▾ menu.

mods.name: Niceties
mods.tagline: Small colony comforts: well-kept apparel, throne-room altars, any outfit cut, hidden cryptosleep, melee hunting, shared bedrooms, and leave a way out while building.
overview: Vanilla never shipped these. Niceties is one Harmony QoL companion: each nicety is its own Mod Options toggle. Soft / Default / Hard only seed the knobs — they are not a forced bundle.

Combat, fire, and outdoor rot stay vanilla. Royalty and Ideology are optional; those toggles no-op without the DLC. Safe to add or remove mid-save. Inspired by older Workshop ideas, rewritten from scratch for 1.6 — not a port of those mods.

features.title: Daily wear by quality
features.body: Worn clothes skip or scale the daily deterioration tick. Quality and Crafting skill decide how often a piece loses a hit point. Masterwork and legendary stay as they are.

features.title: Combat still shreds
features.body: Combat, fire, and outdoor rot are left alone. This is wardrobe care, not invincible armor.

features.title: Corpse clothes
features.body: Optional: apparel on a corpse keeps the same daily-wear rule.

features.title: Altars allowed
features.body: Royalty throne rooms may hold an Ideology altar without failing the no-altars check.

features.title: Throne wins the room
features.body: If a throne is in the room, it stays a throne room rather than flipping to a temple.

features.title: Gender tags off
features.body: Apparel gender tags are captured at load and cleared so mixed royal cuts do not apply the wrong-gender thought.

features.title: Toggle restores tags
features.body: Turn the nicety off and the original tags come back.

features.title: Off the bar
features.body: Pawns already in a cryptosleep casket drop off the colonist bar and reappear when ejected.

features.title: Carrying in stays visible
features.body: Carrying someone to a casket does not hide them early — that crash is what broke older hide-from-bar mods.

features.title: Hunt with a melee weapon
features.body: Hunters may hunt with a melee weapon instead of only a ranged one.

features.title: Body-size cap
features.body: A prey size cap keeps people from charging a thrumbo with a knife unless you raise it.

features.title: Unarmed optional
features.body: Unarmed hunting is off by default.

features.title: Mark the room
features.body: Select a bed and toggle Share room. Every bed in that room shares the flag.

features.title: Stays a bedroom
features.body: Extra beds no longer flip the room to barracks, so Slept in bedroom and royal bedroom requirements still apply.

features.title: No disturbed sleep
features.body: Pawns who share a room — marked, or another colonist assigned a bed there — skip the disturbed-sleep thought. A private room still notices haulers walking through.

features.title: Same mattress
features.body: Sharing one bed with someone who is not a partner is still vanilla.

features.title: Don't wall anyone in
features.body: Pawns skip finishing a wall that would trap someone or block leftover frames. They step aside before closing themselves in.

features.title: Replace Stuff frames
features.body: Unfinished Replace Stuff frames count as open construction, same as vanilla wall frames. In-place wood-to-stone wall replace stays solid, so you can still swap a freezer from inside.

features.title: Force construct
features.body: Right-click force construct still builds it. Do not run alongside Smarter Construction — they overlap the same job.

features.title: Independent toggles
features.body: Each nicety is its own on/off. Nested knobs (quality scaling, unarmed hunt, body-size cap) only apply while that nicety is on.

features.title: Soft
features.body: No daily clothing wear, corpse clothes included, unarmed hunting, any prey size. A starting point — not a bundle you must keep.

features.title: Default
features.body: Quality-scaled wear, melee up to body size 1.5, no unarmed.

features.title: Hard
features.body: No crafting bonus, melee only small game (0.8).

goodToKnow: Safe to add or remove mid-save.
Chinese Simplified and Russian are included.
Requires Harmony. Royalty and Ideology are optional.
Do not run alongside Jecs Everlasting Apparel, Allow Altars in Throneroom, Wear What You Want, Hide Cryptosleep Pawn, Share Rooms [LWM], or Smarter Construction — they overlap the same jobs.
